summary: Comprehensive testing of Farmora AI-powered agricultural assistant completed. Backend APIs 88.9% functional with real Gemini 2.5 Flash, OpenWeatherMap, and News API integrations. Frontend UI excellent with green farmer theme, GPS location capture, multi-language support, and voice input interface.
